title: Transfer trace-guided structural repair to a gated hammer plateau
hypothesis: Successful expert hammer continuations expose missing strike geometry and timing that structural edits can incorporate when parameter search cannot produce success.

prediction.against: matched summary-only edits of the freshly generated hammer plateau parent
prediction.rationale: A 0.30 gain on untouched development cases would establish useful cross-task transfer; the plateau gate prevents attributing an ordinary solvable generation to trace-guided repair.

protocol.command: gpu run -- python scripts/compare_generation_modes.py --config config/two_lane_search_v2.yaml --mode trace-edit-suite --task hammer-v2 --parent-ref fresh --generation-seed 3724 --plateau-probe config/manifests/hammer-v2_development_probe_s3720.yaml --probe-seed 3720 --plateau-screen config/manifests/hammer-v2_development_gate_s3721.yaml --screen-seed 3721 --plateau-candidates 24 --require-zero-plateau --trace-source learner-handoff --demo-manifest config/manifests/hammer-v2_development_traces_s3722.yaml --demo-seed 3722 --demo-episodes 10 --trace-count 2 --trace-stride 4 --edit-scope all-phases --arms summary-only,handoff-trace --block-seeds 3725,3726 --eval-manifest config/manifests/hammer-v2_development_s3723.yaml --manifest-seed 3723 --eval-cases 10:40 --search-candidates 0 --bc-steps 0 --max-repair-per-candidate 1 --model gpt-6.1-sol --reasoning-effort high --temperature 1 --output logs/trace_generalisation/hammer_s3720
code_changes: Extend trace-edit-suite with the shown conditional plateau gate, reusing existing generation and numerical-search machinery rather than adding a script.

Generate one hammer parent with at most one validity correction. Test 24 parameter candidates on five probe cases, including the initial vector; continue only if every candidate has zero success and the selected parent also scores zero on 30 disjoint gate cases.

Collect ten handoff episodes, switching to the calibrated expert after the hammer head rises 3 cm for three consecutive steps. Require two successful continuations and use the first two in manifest order; otherwise stop as inconclusive.

Run two paired edit blocks with identical summaries and full-controller edit permission; only one arm receives every-fourth-step successful continuation traces. Freeze edits before the separate 30-case evaluation, without subsequent search or fitting.
Use the preceding protocols' scoring and interval rules. Episode and call estimates are maximum planned costs before early stopping; require per-idea approval and stop the remote box afterward.

falsified_by: After both eligibility gates pass, trace edits remain unsuccessful or have no positive paired advantage over summary-only edits. Failure to establish a generator plateau or obtain two successful handoffs is inconclusive, not a refutation.
